sources.quote: 动态2026 年 4 月 24 日
sources.supports: Dates the provider's V4 launch announcement to April 24, 2026.

sources.quote: 旧有的 API 接口的两个模型名 deepseek-chat 与 deepseek-reasoner 将于三个月后（2026-07-24）停止使用。当前阶段内，这两个模型名分别指向 deepseek-v4-flash 的非思考模式与思考模式。
sources.supports: Provider says deepseek-reasoner mapped to V4-Flash during the period beginning with the launch announcement; the accompanying official price graphic lists V4-Flash at $0.14 input, $0.28 output, and $0.028 cache hit per million tokens.
Official V4 launch pricing graphic, embedded in the announcement, gives the V4-Flash rates corresponding to the new prices.
Independent provider documentation changelog dates the V4 API update to April 24, 2026.

notes: The provider's April 24, 2026 V4 announcement says the legacy deepseek-reasoner name pointed to V4-Flash, and its attached official pricing graphic lists the new V4-Flash rates. The provider page dates the announcement but gives no time of day, so the effective time is stated only to the day. Internet Archive CDX was unavailable (connection failure), so I could not retrieve archived provider pricing pages; consequently the earlier rates are not independently established here and official_previous_price is null.
